title: Waiver Charge Base in the Term Life Insurance Waiver Removal Reckoning
content:
**Actuarial note — Term Life Insurance.** In the waiver removal reckoning, which sets the installment after the waiver of premium rider ends, the waiver charge base is chosen by the insured's issue age (whole years from the insured's date of birth to the issue date on record).

- Issue age 40 or more: the face premium plus the accidental death charge plus the children's term charge.
- Issue age 30 through 39: the face premium plus the accidental death charge.
- Issue age below 30: the face premium alone.

| Hypothetical components | Issue age 41 | Issue age 36 | Issue age 28 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Face premium 1000.00 | included | included | included |
| Accidental death charge 96.00 | included | included | — |
| Children's term charge 33.00 | included | — | — |
| Waiver charge base | 1129.00 | 1096.00 | 1000.00 |

The charges entering the base are those of the same reckoning, as they stand for the policy on record.
